ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory EDD for PEPs under Ley 10/2010 art. 14, including family members and close associates, with PEP status retained for at least 12 months after leaving public office. Systematic screening of all UBOs, directors, authorized signatories, and counterparties against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions File (FSF), OFAC SDN and Consolidated Non-SDN Lists (given USD payment rails), and SEPBLAC operational guidance. For ISIC 4220 gas/oil-pipeline EPC with Sovereign_Project_Wire and Letter_of_Credit rails, the Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier requires enhanced CDD: source-of-wealth evidence, corporate structure unwinding, country-risk assessment, and continuous transaction monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) - electronic application for the Certificacion Negativa de Denominacion Social through www.rmc.es (Colegio de Registradores de Espana portal), with telematic DUE integration via CIRCE under Ley 18/2022 (Crea y Crece)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be expressed in Spanish (Castilian) or in a co-official regional language (Catalan/Valencian, Galician, Basque). Foreign words are admissible only if transliterated into Latin script, are not identical or confusingly similar to registered names, and do not mislead as to the corporate type or reserved public significance. For a gas-pipeline EPC company, technical terms such as 'Gas', 'Hidrocarburos', 'Infraestructuras', 'Oleoducto', or 'EPC' may be used descriptively but must not dominate the distinctive core word that differentiates the company.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'Espana' if used within a public-law context, requiring prior authorization of the Council of Ministers
'Nacional', 'Internacional', 'Ministerio', 'Gobierno', 'Estado', 'Oficial', 'Real', 'Monarquia' (reserved terms requiring prior ministerial or royal authorization)
'Banco de Espana', 'Comision Nacional', 'Consejo General', and names of constitutional or regulatory institutions
'Union Europea', 'Naciones Unidas', 'Organizacion Mundial', 'Organizacion de los Estados Americanos' (supranational and international organization names)
'Sociedad Anonima', 'S.L.', 'S.A.', 'Limitada' (permitted only as the true legal-form designation, not as part of the distinctive core)
Trademarks and well-known corporate identifiers in the energy sector, e.g., 'ENAGAS', 'REPSOL', 'IBERDROLA', 'NATURGY', 'GAS NATURAL'
Professional reserved terms such as 'Abogado', 'Auditor', 'Medico', 'Ingeniero' unless the corresponding professional license is held
'Hidrocarburos' and 'Gas' when combined with a governmental or national-reaching token (e.g., 'Nacional de Hidrocarburos') so as to suggest a state or licensed monopoly entity
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The Certificacion Negativa de Denominacion Social is valid for 3 months (90 days) from issuance; no extension is available, and upon expiry a new electronic application must be filed with the Registro Mercantil Central. In case of refusal, the applicant may (i) file an optional recurso de reposicion before the same RMC body within one month of notification, or (ii) file a recurso de alzada directly with the Direccion General de Seguridad Juridica y Fe Publica (DGSJFP) of the Ministry of Justice within one month of notification, all in accordance with Ley 39/2015 (LPACAP, arts. 112-123). Alternatively, the applicant may immediately request a fresh certificate in a modified distinctive denomination at a marginal official fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Restricted. Article 9 of the Ley de Sociedades de Capital (Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010) requires the domicilio social to be situated in Spain at the place where the effective administration and management center or the principal establishment is located, and Article 10 requires the registered office to coincide with any Spanish-based principal establishment. A virtual office is acceptable only for the initial filing if it is supported by a genuine administrative presence (e.g., the registered office of a gestor or law firm performing substantive functions); a pure mailbox address without physical activity may be recharacterized by the tax authorities under Article 48.3 Ley 58/2003 (General Tributaria) and challenged by the Registro Mercantil. Given the ISIC 4220 gas-pipeline EPC profile, Enhanced-Risk AML tier, and Sovereign_Project_Wire revenue model, a physical Spanish headquarters or project office is strongly advised.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated at 45-60% within the first 18-24 months of incorporation. SEPBLAC (Servicio Ejecutivo de la Comision de Prevencion del Blanqueo de Capitales e Infracciones Monetarias) and the Bank of Spain undertake risk-based on-site AML/CFT inspections, with the Medium_Risk_Enhanced rating, cross-border infrastructure operations, and government-linked payment rails materially increasing selection probability. Agencia Estatal de Administracion Tributaria (AEAT) may also conduct unannounced substance verifications for VAT, corporate tax, and permanent-establishment purposes.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 of 2 July, approving the consolidated text of the Spanish Capital Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), particularly Articles 9-28 (formation), 29-40 (capital), 58-59 (registered office), and 209-233 (administration).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry) and the territorial Registro Mercantil of the province where the registered office is situated, under the Ministry of Justice.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura pública de constitución (public deed of incorporation) granted before a Spanish notary and filed with the Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum share capital of EUR 3,000 (approx. USD 3,250) must be fully subscribed and paid up at incorporation. Capital may be in cash or non-cash assets and must be deposited in a blocked escrow account with a Spanish financial institution until registration is completed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF SOCIEDAD DE RESPONSABILIDAD LIMITADA [SL Name], executed in Madrid on [Date]. The founding members resolve: (1) to approve the public deed of incorporation and adopt the company’s by-laws; (2) to confirm the subscription and full payment of the share capital of EUR 3,000, allocated as follows: [Member A] and [Member B] each for the number of participations set out in the deed; (3) to establish and adopt the registered office at [address], Spain; and (4) to appoint [Name] as Sole Administrator (Administrador Único), accepting office. The Administrator is expressly authorized to execute registry filings and obtain NIF and operating licenses. Approved unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Madrid (online application portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application for a negative certificate of company name (certificación de denominación social). Provide at least three proposed corporate names in order of preference. The certificate confirms that no existing Spanish company is registered under the proposed name and remains valid for three months.
required_dossiers: Identity documents (passport or DNI) of each founding member
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is identical or confusingly similar to an existing company, select the next alternative name from the submitted list and resubmit the application; no formal appeal is needed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary restricted account in the name of the Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada under formation and deposit at least EUR 3,000. Obtain a certificate of deposit (certificado de desembolso) that must be presented to the notary at the execution of the deed.
required_dossiers: Identity documents and NIE of incorporators
Corporate purpose description for bank due diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests an NIE for the account holder, obtain a provisional NIE from the nearest Spanish consulate or police station, or select another eligible financial institution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Granting of Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary in the jurisdiction of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Attend a notarial appointment with all founding members and present the name certificate, bank deposit certificate, drafted by-laws, and valid identification. The notary will review legality, execute the escritura pública de constitución, and issue notarial first copies for subsequent filings.
required_dossiers: Passports/DNI and NIE certificates of all incorporators
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies legal defects, amend the by-laws or corporate documentation and reschedule the notarial appointment; no negative record is created by the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Documented Legal Acts Tax (AJD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tax Agency of the relevant Autonomous Community (Agencia Tributaria Autonómica)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarial deed with the regional tax authority and self-assess the Documented Legal Acts Tax (Impuesto sobre Actos Jurídicos Documentados, modalidad operaciones societarias) at the applicable regional rate. Obtain the payment certificate to present to the Commercial Registry.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office recalculates a higher liability, the company must pay the additional amount plus late-payment interest; present the updated payment receipt to the registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), local tax office or online
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and submit Spanish tax form 030 to register the company in the Censo de Empresarios and obtain the provisional Tax Identification Number (NIF provisional) before commercial registry inscription is completed.
required_dossiers: Proof of fiscal representation, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the form contains errors, correct the data and resubmit electronically; AEAT usually allows immediate rectification without additional fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Territorial Registro Mercantil of the province of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarial first copy, proof of AJD payment, and provisional NIF to the Commercial Registry. The registry examiner verifies the deed, by-laws, and capital rules. Upon approval, the SL is registered and becomes a legal entity; the registry issues a certificate of registration.
required_dossiers: Notarial first copy of the public deed
Copy of bylaws and capital certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a note of defects, respond in writing within the legal period with curative documentation or execute a supplementary notarial deed resolving the objections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive NIF, IAE Census and Social Security Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After inscription, submit form 030 again to convert the provisional NIF into a permanent NIF. If the SL will carry out an activity subject to local taxation, register in the Impuesto sobre Actividades Económicas (IAE) and, if hiring employees, register as an employer with the Social Security Treasury.
required_dossiers: Social Security employer registration form TA.6
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT or Social Security rejects the filing, correct the data or missing attachments and resubmit; any related late-filing surcharges can be contested with the registry certificate showing the date of legal formation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism (Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Turismo), acting through the Directorate General for Industry and Small and Medium Enterprises, with regional cooperation from the Autonomous Community industry authorities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Administrative construction and operation authorization for high-pressure gas pipelines under Law 34/1998 on the Hydrocarbon Sector (Autorización administrativa de instalación and autorización de puesta en servicio).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge (Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico, MITECO), Directorate General for Environmental Quality and Assessment, and the corresponding regional environmental authority.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full Environmental Impact Assessment report under Law 21/2013, because cross-country oil and gas pipelines above the statutory length thresholds and affecting multiple regions are classified as Annex I projects; some smaller or non-sensitive segments may fall under the simplified environmental impact assessment or administrative environmental authorization.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Hydrostatic test wastewater and industrial discharges must comply with the water quality standards of Royal Decree 849/1986 and the regional water authority. Fugitive VOC emissions and combustion emissions from compressors must meet BAT-AEL thresholds under Law 1/2016 on Integrated Pollution Prevention and Control. Hazardous waste handling must conform to Law 7/2022 and packaging and waste management regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the regional fire protection service, structural load inspection for above-ground installations, workplace occupational safety clearance from the National Institute of Safety and Health at Work (INSST), and operational clearance from the local authority confirming compliance with public safety and emergency response requirements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL) incorporated in Spain must obtain a definitive Spanish Tax Identification Number (NIF) from AEAT before beginning operations. For a non-resident parent entity establishing the SL, the parent must first be assigned a non-resident NIF (NIF-N) by AEAT. The SL's NIF application is filed at the local AEAT office or through an authorized representative, attaching: (i) certified copies of the public deed of incorporation, (ii) official registration certificate from the Mercantile Registry indicating the fiscal address, (iii) the company's corporate bylaws, (iv) power of attorney granted to the tax representative if applicable, and (v) identification documents of the legal representative. Temporary NIF envelopes are replaced by the definitive NIF card, and the SL must notify AEAT of any subsequent change in registered office, activity, or management within one month.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (Spanish SL is resident in Spain and is subject to corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) on its worldwide income; no pass-through regime applies to SLs, though individually held qualifying SMEs may elect the 20% reduced rate within the general entity-level framework)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not offer US-style check-the-box elections. For SLs, the principal optional regimes are: (i) tax consolidation election for 75%-owned Spanish operating subsidiaries and parent companies (permanent regime requiring agreement and AEAT notification); (ii) the Spanish privileged holding regime (ETVE) for qualifying non-resident shareholdings; (iii) the young company reduced-rate election for new SMEs; and (iv) the special neutrality regime for asset contributions/mergers under Directive 2009/133/EC. Under the national provisions transposing ATAD and the EU Anti-Tax-Avoidance Directive (EU) 2017/952, hybrid mismatch elections must be reported via an information statement if the taxpayer chooses alternative treatment where permitted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No functioning turnover threshold for non-established foreign businesses: non-resident suppliers making any taxable supplies in mainland Spain must register for Spanish VAT (NIF-IVA) from the first transaction. For established Spanish SMEs, the simplified VAT regime is available only for turnover not exceeding €250,000 per calendar year, but registration for VAT is still mandatory from the first taxable activity. The EU-wide distance-selling threshold of €10,000 applies to cross-border B2C distance sales of goods arriving in Spain, after which Spanish registration becomes mandatory.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The 'Suministro Inmediato de Información' (SII) requires VAT-registered businesses with annual turnover exceeding €6,010,121.04 (or those in certain VAT groups) to submit detailed invoices and customs data electronically to AEAT within four calendar days of issuance/receipt. In addition, the 'Verifactu' rules (Royal Decree implementing the 'Crea y Crece' framework) mandate a standardized electronic invoicing format (≥ 2025/2026) for B2B transactions, requiring a secure invoice file containing a hash identifier, the issuer's VAT identification, and for certain transactions an AR/AS referral code in specified XML or EDIFACT formats. Exports of goods require the customs export declaration to be transmitted through the electronic Customs (Aduanas) processing system; no separate 'digital stamp' is required beyond the customs TARIC-related date and exit confirmation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Spanish VAT is zero-rated (0%) on the export of goods physically leaving the EU customs territory (art. 21 Ley 37/1992 IVA) and on certain services directly related to the export, as well as on international transport services of goods and ancillary services (arts. 24, 30 IVA). For an ISIC 4220 cross-country oil/gas pipeline EPC contractor, the 0% applies to supplies of goods dispatched or transported to a third country (non-EU) by the seller or a third party, provided the goods are delivered outside EU customs territory. Services physically rendered offshore (i.e., drilling, trenching, welding, pipeline construction outside the EU) are treated as exported services under the territoriality rule of art. 70.uno.7º IVA and are zero-rated if the recipient is a non-establishment in Spain and the service is not used in Spain. The pipeline contractor must retain contemporaneous evidence of the export flow: possession of a valid Spanish export customs declaration (DUA), transport documents showing exit from the EU (CMR, B/L, AWB), and proof that the goods have not been altered or used before export. No refund arises if the VAT is already zero-rated; VAT incurred on inputs attributable to these exports is deductible and, if the deduction exceeds output VAT, the contractor can claim an annual refund from AEAT. A partner in a consortium or sub-contractor may also use the 'Direct Export' or 'Indirect Export' e-document modules in the AEAT electronic portal.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA – Documento Único Administrativo)
Bill of Lading or other transport document proving physical departure from the European Union
Inward Remittance Certificate (certificado de recepción de cobro) evidence of the foreign exchange repatriation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT conducts targeted post-clearance audits on exporters claiming zero-rating for high-value cross-border works, especially EPC projects in the hydrocarbon/pipeline sector because of the large VAT and volume of goods. Where zero-rating is inaccurately claimed, AEAT assesses the unpaid VAT (21% of the export value) plus late-payment interest, and may issue a formal regularización (clawback) for the prior four years. For false or incomplete export documentation, the penalty ranges from 50% to 150% of the ceiling assessed (arts. 191, 194 LGT); in cases of malicious falsification, criminal tax fraud (art. 305 CP) may be prosecuted with penalties of imprisonment and fines. A refund misappropriated due to unlawful zero-rating is recaptured immediately, and approximately seven years of audit records (including the export dummy and the transport/remittance evidence) are required for any potential clawback and refutation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), together with the Spanish Ministry of Economy, Trade and Enterprise (Registro de Inversiones Exteriores - Foreign Investment Registry), as the competent authorities for exchange control statistical reporting and cross-border capital movement declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain, as a eurozone member, maintains full convertibility for both current account and capital account transactions under the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (Articles 63-65). Profit remittance is unrestricted once Spanish corporate formalities (mercantile registry filing of annual accounts, corporate income tax settlement, and, where applicable, Form 232/CEF reporting) are completed. For non-EU counterparties, only statistical declarations are triggered, not convertibility restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or conversion ratio is imposed. Exporters may retain 100% of proceeds in foreign currency or convert freely to EUR. Foreign exchange receipts must be routed through an authorised Spanish credit institution or payment institution, and each individual cross-border transaction equal to or exceeding EUR 100,000 (or the equivalent in another currency) must be reported to the Banco de España via the corresponding statistical operation declaration, submitted within the monthly reporting cycle established under Banco de España Circular 4/2005 and subsequent implementing resolutions. The declaration is transmitted through the collecting credit institution; no separate surrender timeline applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de no residente) / Operational Account (Cuenta corriente)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium - legally viable for EUR-denominated pass-through payments if the EMI holds a full PSD2 European passport from a recognised EEA competent authority, but low suitability for large gas-pipeline EPC payments because Spanish banks and counterparties require onshore legacy banking rails, documentary credits, and direct Banco de España reporting capacity. EMIs also face compliance friction in supporting cross-currency forwards and commercial letters of credit.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not an absolute statutory mandate for residents of Spain, but non-resident directors and ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) should expect bank-level policy requiring either in-branch identity verification, video-identification by a notary, or a certified notarial power of attorney granted to a Spanish-resident authorised signatory. Large-tier banks (Santander, BBVA, CaixaBank) will, in practice, mandate at least one face-to-face/biometric KYC interview for the SL's director before operational accounts are activated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident 100% shareholder ownership in a high-tax/offshore jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport of each UBO and director; register of ultimate beneficial ownership from the Spanish UBO Registry (Registro de Titularidades Reales); notarised bank reference letter; source-of-funds affidavit with supporting bank statements for the last 24 months; corporate charter and shareholders' register; clean criminal record certificates from all residence jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex EPC back-to-back payment flows and third-party trade payables
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed EPC master contract and subcontracts; proforma invoices; pipeline construction licence and ISIC 4220 engineering certifications; bank-verified proof of equity and financing; escrow agreements; transaction flow diagram disclosing all intermediary accounts and ultimate payees.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sectoral exposure to infrastructure projects causing politically exposed persons (PEPs) in procurement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PEP screening declarations from shareholders and project counterparties; enhanced due-diligence questionnaire; procurement tenders with PEP written confirmation; sanctions checks against EU and OFAC lists; statement of source of funds for all payments above EUR 50,000.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapidly accumulated cash balances inconsistent with project milestones
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Milestones table certified by the independent engineer; commitment letters from lenders; board resolutions approving injections; discrepancy report and correspondence with the Spanish tax agency (AEAT) confirming tax compliance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity or primary intra-group loans must be remitted to the Spanish SL's dedicated capital account via SWIFT MT103/MT202, quoting the appropriate Spanish balance-of-payments statistical code (J01 for foreign direct investment in Spain or J02 for non-equity direct investment) and referencing the SL's tax identification number (NIF). The bank will require the shareholder resolution and, if the investor is non-EU, an ex-post investment declaration submitted to the Foreign Investment Registry when the investor reaches 10% of share capital or the invested amount exceeds EUR 3,000,000 in accordance with Royal Decree 571/2023 and the Spanish Ministry of Economy framework. For sums below those thresholds, the bank still requires the statistical balance-of-payments declaration for any individual transaction equal to or exceeding EUR 100,000.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements should be executed over SWIFT MT103 (customer credit transfer) for operational payments, and for large pipe and equipment procurements use irrevocable commercial letters of credit (L/C) issued under UCP 600, either sight or usance, with the Spanish SL's bank as issuing bank and the beneficiaries' confirming banks. For payments abroad to non-EU jurisdictions, the Spanish bank requires the balance-of-payments statistical declaration to be filed by the SL (when the individual payment equals or exceeds EUR 100,000) and proper transaction code registration. Multi-currency payments can be remitted in EUR, USD, or other currencies subject to the bank's FX desk quoting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable FX forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CNY, or project-currency pairs) with a Spanish credit institution
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for illiquid or exotic currencies of counterparty sub-suppliers where physical delivery is impossible, subject to bank appetite and ISDA/ESA documentation
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for long-term USD project receivables converted to EUR-linked liabilities
FX options (call or put on EUR) to hedge milestone-based receivable positions without binding delivery obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 January following the close of the calendar-year VAT period.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or incorrect filing is an informative-return infringement; LGT penalty scale starts at EUR 175 and can reach EUR 5,000, plus interest if underlying VAT is affected. No direct strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalisation of mandatory corporate and accounting books (legalización de libros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry of the registered office (Registro Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after financial year-end; for calendar-year SL, on or before 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unlegalised books lose evidentiary effect in legal proceedings; the registry may refuse later legalisation and the annual accounts deposit can be queried; repeated failure supports audit qualification. No direct automatic strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ordinary General Meeting approval of annual accounts and application of result (Junta General Ordinaria)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Meeting recorded in the corporate Minute Book; not filed until accounts deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year SL, no later than 30 June of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No government fine for lateness by itself, but directors are liable for corporate losses and the accounts cannot be validly deposited until approved; prolonged failure supports winding-up petitions and registry closure of the file.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Modelo 200, Impuesto sobre Sociedades)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year tax period, on or before 25 July of the following year (25 days after the six-month period following the tax-period close).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late self-assessment triggers Article 27 LGT surcharges of 5%, 10%, 15% or 20% depending on delay, plus late-payment interest and collection enforcement; no administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year tax period, on or before 25 July of the following year; required where aggregate related-party transactions with a single related person exceed EUR 250,000 in the tax period.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing of the informative return is penalised under LGT; minimum fine EUR 175 for each required data block or group, with total penalties adjustable for deliberate obstruction; no direct strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual accounts with the Mercantile Registry (depósito de cuentas anuales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry of the registered office (Registro Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the General Meeting; for calendar-year SL approved by 30 June, on or before 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit causes closure of the company's registration sheet (cierre registral), blocking all subsequent registry filings; official penalties for late filing range from EUR 120 to EUR 2,000; repeated multi-year non-deposit can lead to administrative deregistration (baja de oficio) after formal proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ultimate beneficial owner declaration (declaración de titularidad real)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil (submitted with annual accounts deposit; underlying AML registration under Law 10/2010)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the annual accounts deposit; for calendar-year SL, on or before 31 July, or within one month after approval if earlier.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission prevents acceptance of annual accounts deposit and may trigger AML administrative penalties under Law 10/2010 for serious breaches; no direct strike-off but creates formal registry non-compliance.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% corporate income tax rate for newly created Sociedades de Responsabilidad Limitada in the first two taxable periods with positive taxable income from an economic activity; R&D tax credit up to 42%, innovation tax credit up to 25%, and reduced effective taxation through the Spanish patent box regime for qualified intangible assets.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 200 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) filed electronically through the Sede Electrónica de la Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT). Modelo 220 applies for consolidated groups.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 25 calendar days following the six-month period after the end of the tax year. For a 31 December year-end, the filing window is 1 to 25 July, or the next business day if the deadline falls on a non-business day.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identification fields: NIF, corporate name, tax domicile, and accounting closing date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a resident Spanish SL, enter the Spanish NIF. Non-resident shareholders are not listed here; for a non-resident permanent establishment, enter the branch NIF and separate domicile data.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting result before tax: net profit per Spanish GAAP financial statements prior to corporate income tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A resident SL must file all Spanish-source and worldwide income of the corporate vehicle. A non-resident PE must enter the income attributable to the Spanish PE under Article 22 of the Spanish Corporate Income Tax Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Permanent and temporary differences: reconciliation from accounting result to taxable income (base imponible).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support all adjustments with contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation for related-party pipeline engineering and construction transactions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses carried forward offset against positive taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Spanish tax-recognized negative tax bases may be offset; provide a full electronic file of loss carryforward positions for audit review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits and withholding taxes: offset of withheld dividends, interest, real estate income, and prepayments made under Modelo 202.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits are claimed by the resident SL only where a DTA or domestic unilateral relief applies; non-resident shareholders must use Modelo 210 for refund of final withholding on distributions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance to pay or refund, IBAN, and electronic authorization of transfer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use a Spanish bank account for settlement. Outstanding amounts are enforced via embargo of bank assets and penalties if unpaid after the deadline.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge: 5% if filed within 3 months after the deadline, 10% for 3 to 6 months, 15% for 6 to 12 months, 20% after 12 months, plus late payment interest. Where the late return shows no tax due, fixed penalties under the LGT may apply; non-filing after AEAT notice attracts an additional 50% assessment plus tax interest.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a Double Taxation Agreement rate, the non-resident beneficiary must obtain a certificate of tax residence (TRC) from the relevant foreign tax authority and deliver it to the Spanish paying SL before the dividend is paid. If the TRC is not available pre-payment, the payor must withhold at the statutory 19% and the recipient must claim a refund using Modelo 210 within the applicable four-year statute of limitations. The paying company must also verify beneficial ownership and economic substance to avoid treaty abuse challenges.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: statutory 19%; reduced to 0% under EU Council Directive 2003/49/EC for qualifying EU associated enterprises, or reduced to 5-10% under typical Spanish DTAs. Royalties on IP: statutory 19%; reduced to 0% under the same EU directive for qualifying EU associated enterprises, or to 5-10% under applicable DTAs.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 1,000,000 in aggregate annual related-party transactions triggers mandatory Spanish transfer pricing documentation (Local File); Master File documentation becomes mandatory for groups with consolidated net turnover equal to or above EUR 45,000,000, and Country-by-Country reporting is required for groups with consolidated revenue above EUR 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain does not apply an OECD-type Economic Substance Regulation separate from tax law, but treaty and EU-directive relief is conditional on beneficial ownership and real economic substance. The Spanish General Tax Act provides substance-first rules and general anti-abuse measures under which artificial structures, absence of local staff, and lack of management and risk control may be disregarded, and income can be reclassified as Spanish-source taxable income.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understating EPC pipeline contract revenues, submitting false progress certificates, issuing pass-through invoicing, or concealing cash payments received from public construction contracts to reduce taxable corporate profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal Code Article 305: imprisonment of 1 to 5 years and a fine of up to six times the defrauded amount where evasion exceeds EUR 120,000. Administrative surcharge under the General Tax Act of 50% to 100% of the underpaid tax, loss of tax benefits and prohibition on contracting with the public sector for up to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be held jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid tax under LGT Article 42 where their negligent or willful action caused the tax debt. In criminal cases, the court may order imprisonment, travel bans, asset seizure, and civil compensation orders without reliance on the corporate veil.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Spanish SL with nominee directors, no office, no employees, and no operational control, while channelling the pipeline contract profits to a foreign related company through non-commercial management fees or artificial subcontracting arrangements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax administration may disregard the artificial vehicle under LGT Article 13 and recharacterise the taxable income as Spanish-source. Penalties range from 50% to 150% of the additional tax assessment; the company may also be struck off the Commercial Register if insolvency or sham elements are proven.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Judicial piercing of the corporate veil can make shareholders and directors personally liable for corporate debts and unpaid taxes. Where fraudulent intent is established, imposition of travel bans, civil asset tracing, and disqualification from board positions is possible.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring sovereign project wire payments, letters of credit, or mobilization advances into layering transactions, commingling personal and corporate funds, or using an offshore beneficial owner to disguise the origin or control of pipeline-related funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Law 10/2010 on prevention of money laundering: serious breaches attract fines up to EUR 1,000,000 or up to 5% of net worth; criminal money laundering under Criminal Code Article 301 carries imprisonment from 6 months to 6 years, fines, and confiscation of assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors formally designated as responsible by the AML regime may be personally fined and banned from banking operations. The corporate veil is ignored where assets were fraudulently routed; personal freezing orders and travel bans are imposed in serious cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Missing Local File or Master File, failing to benchmark arm's length margins for the pipeline EPC subcontractor, or recording intra-group financing and IP charges without demonstration of comparability or benefit test.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Failure to provide transfer pricing documentation attracts a penalty of EUR 1,000 per missing or incomplete item with a minimum of EUR 1,500 per year. The tax inspector may make a transfer pricing adjustment and impose an additional 15% valuation penalty plus late payment interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: CEOs and CFOs who knowingly prepared or approved false transfer pricing documentation may be derivatively liable under LGT Article 42. Negligent involvement can expose personal financial liability, and materially false declarations with tax prejudice may trigger criminal tax charges.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing profits to a foreign shareholder disguised as repayment of shareholder loans or as deductible management fees without satisfying loan genuineness or transfer pricing requirements, and failing to withhold 19% Spanish dividend tax or apply a DTA correctly.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Spanish SL, as payer, is jointly liable for the withheld amount plus late payment interest and LGT penalty of 50% to 100% of the missing withholding. If the disguised distribution exceeds EUR 120,000 and is intentional, criminal prosecution under Article 305 is available.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approved the disguised distribution are jointly liable for the unpaid withholding tax. Courts may order personal asset embargo, civil compensation to the treasury, and imprisonment where fraud or concealment is proven.
